content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

This stack is built on base-layer tools: GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and Google Drive for file delivery. NOWPayments handles crypto payments with a 0.5% fee. No KYC. No buyer accounts. The webhook fires the moment payment confirms on-chain. You own the entire stack after deployment. No platform locks you out. No payout delays. Pressure-tested in Zimbabwe against currency collapse and financial isolation. This isn’t a workaround—it’s infrastructure sovereignty.
What You Need Before You Deploy

You need a digital product to sell, a crypto wallet to receive USDT, and basic familiarity with GitHub or Cloudflare. Choose Tron or Solana for low transaction fees. Tron costs under $0.10 per transaction. Solana averages fractions of a cent. Set up a NOWPayments account. No KYC required. Select the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197) based on your needs. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and templates for full customization.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Deploy your stack in 48 hours. GitHub Pages hosts your storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets stores orders. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files. NOWPayments verifies USDT payments on-chain. Configure the webhook to trigger product delivery instantly. Test end-to-end before going live. The Edge Commerce Stack includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC setup for email delivery. You own the code. You control the pipeline.
USDT on Tron costs under $0.10 per transaction. Solana fees are fractions of a cent.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Load your products into the stack. Set prices in USDT. Share your storefront link. When a buyer pays, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain. The webhook triggers instant product delivery. Monitor transactions in Supabase or Google Sheets. Convert USDT to local currency via P2P exchanges like Binance or Patricia. No payout delays. No platform fees. Your infrastructure runs 24/7 without your intervention.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The transaction log in a COREMERCH deployment provides a complete, independently verifiable audit trail of every payment. Each entry includes the transaction hash, which links directly to the public blockchain record. You can verify any transaction independently on Tronscan, Etherscan, Solscan, or the relevant blockchain explorer — no platform intermediary required. If a buyer claims they paid but the transaction does not appear in your order log, you check the blockchain directly. This level of cryptographic verifiability is structurally impossible with conventional payment processors.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

USDT payments on Tron or Solana arrive in minutes, not days. Tron transactions cost under $0.10. Solana fees are fractions of a cent. NOWPayments verifies payments on-chain, triggering instant product delivery. Compare this to PayPal’s 2-5 business day payouts or Gumroad’s delays. Your buyers pay in USDT. You receive it instantly. Convert to local currency via P2P exchanges like Binance or Patricia. No middlemen. No payout freezes.
NOWPayments verifies payments on-chain. No KYC. No buyer accounts.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The complete payment pipeline — from buyer checkout to local currency in your account — involves three components: NOWPayments for on-chain verification, your sovereign stack backend for order processing and delivery, and a P2P exchange for conversion to local currency. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the first two components under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete process including P2P conversion guidance for Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, and Bangladesh. Both available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose Tron or Solana for USDT payments. 2. Set up a NOWPayments account. 3. Deploy GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting. 4. Configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic. 5. Use Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. 6. Set up Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. 7. Test the webhook integration with NOWPayments. 8. Load your products into the stack. 9. Share your storefront link with buyers. 10. Monitor transactions and convert USDT via P2P exchanges.

Use NOWPayments to accept USDT on Tron or Solana. Integrate the webhook to trigger instant product delivery. Network fees are under $0.10 per transaction.

USDT payments confirm in minutes. PayPal payouts take 2-5 business days. NOWPayments verifies USDT on-chain, triggering instant delivery.

Use P2P exchanges like Binance or Patricia to convert Bitcoin or USDT to naira. No bank accounts required. Instant settlement.

Replicate your stack for new products or storefronts. Use Cloudflare Pages and Workers for enterprise-grade performance. The Complete Builder Kit includes scaling blueprints.
